content.message: I recommend the Kenmore espresso machine with grinder and milk frother listed at Kohl’s for $764.99. Its matched page describes a conical burr grinder with 30 settings and a steam wand, covering whole-bean preparation and manual milk steaming. It leaves $35.01 under your equipment limit. I reasonably expect a household package of this kind to include its standard operating accessories and suit US power, although the frozen evidence does not enumerate the accessories or explicitly establish voltage. Expect some practice adjusting the grind and steaming milk, plus routine cleaning; two sequential morning drinks are a reasonable use case.

candidates.evidence_and_reason: The Kenmore listing at Kohl’s describes an espresso machine with a grinder and milk frother. The accompanying message reports a conical burr grinder and steam wand, supporting the required functions, although those details are not independently established. At $764.99, the integrated setup plausibly offers an approachable starting point for two sequential milk drinks, with practice and routine cleaning. Kohl’s is the displayed merchant, providing some seller-confidence benefit under a broad retailer reputation assumption. Evidence does not establish exceptional drink consistency or durability.

Avoids spending and product uncertainty but leaves the user without equipment. The available household offer provides a sufficiently credible prospect of meeting the stated needs to prefer purchasing.
